title: Manna in the Wilderness
summary: God provides daily help and teaches His people to trust Him one day at a time. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Exodus 16:1-18 and look for how this passage teaches: God provides daily help and teaches His people to trust Him one day at a time.

tell_it: Israel was hungry in the wilderness. God gave manna each morning and taught them to gather what they needed.
understand_it: God provides daily help and teaches His people to trust Him one day at a time. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Manna in the Wilderness reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Provision matters.
age_8_11_explanation: Manna in the Wilderness shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: God provides daily help and teaches His people to trust Him one day at a time.
teen_explanation: Manna in the Wilderness gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that god provides daily help and teaches His people to trust Him one day at a time. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: God provides daily help and teaches His people to trust Him one day at a time.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when provision is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: What food did God give in the wilderness?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: Manna. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that god provides daily help and teaches His people to trust Him one day at a time.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Exodus 16:15 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Manna in the Wilderness?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Daily Bread Basket
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: God provides daily help and teaches His people to trust Him one day at a time.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Manna in the Wilderness. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
